full_image.question: Describe this image in one short sentence.

object.question: What is the main object in this image? Ignore the black padding. Answer with a short noun phrase.
What does the main object look like? Describe its visible appearance in one short sentence. Ignore the black padding.
How many main objects are visible in this image? Ignore the black padding. Answer with a single number, or unknown if uncertain.
What is the main object doing? Answer with a short phrase. If no action is visible, answer unknown.

context.question: Describe the visible scene in one short sentence. Ignore the black area.
What does the visible ground look like? Answer briefly. Ignore the black area. If no ground is visible, answer unknown.
What is visible around the black area? Describe only what is visible, in one short sentence. Do not guess what is hidden.
